propositions: Container tickets with empty file_impact fall back to whole-HEAD invalidation, causing over-invalidation on every commit to the base ref

A container's signed dependency set should inherit the union of its non-closed direct children's declared file_impact, applying a poison rule: if any non-closed direct child has empty file_impact, inheritance is disabled and the set remains empty (whole-HEAD fallback)
Child file_impact edits should invalidate a container's attestation via material fingerprint drift, triggering re-review that recomputes the inherited union
Plan-review pass 9 (P9) must surface an advisory (non-blocking) when a container's inheritance is poisoned, naming the offending children with empty file_impact
The children list must be threaded from the orchestrator's assembled context through sign_plan_review into dependency_hashes, avoiding new store reads and preserving fail-closed semantics
